description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: Plannotator is a plan review UI for Claude Code that intercepts `ExitPlanMode` via hooks, letting users approve or request changes with annotated feedback. It also provides code review for git diffs and annotation of arbitrary Markdown files.

This file is a map. The full guidance lives in focused guides under [`docs/agent-guides/`](docs/agent-guides/). Read the hard rules below, then the guide for the code or behavior you are changing. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to this file; `packages/ui/AGENTS.md` adds guidance scoped to `packages/ui/`.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
